_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: EXACT, but only if the in-kind row is counted: the 9 MONETARY rows sum to 8,460.00 and the single IN-KIND row (9/10/16 State Board of Realtors, 'Like-Kind Donation - Auto', 270.00, shipped in_kind=true) brings the ledger to 8,730.00 - the printed >$50 box and the cover's stated total to the cent. NOTE THE SOURCE PROPERTY: this filer INCLUDED his in-kind donation in the contribution total, which runs opposite to the McKenna-2024 precedent that Summit's cover contribution figure is monetary-only. recon.itemized is the monetary sum (8,460.00) per the wave contract; the residual 270.00 is the in-kind row, NOT a missing donor and NOT the <=$50 aggregate (that box is a nil dash and is blank). split50 sheet: only donors >$50 are itemizable, and every itemized row here is >$50 (smallest 60.00), so there is no structural residual on this side.

expenditures.detail: DOES NOT GATE against either printed figure, and the two printed figures disagree with each other. The schedule's own boxed total is $7,710.68 (tight-crop verified at 1400 dpi); the cover this module already transcribed states 7,560.88; the 11 transcribed rows sum to 7,509.79 - i.e. -200.89 against the schedule box and -51.09 against the cover. Every amount was re-read as an individual 1400-2000 dpi cell crop: 89.00, 50.00, 1,200.00, 276.59, 1,611.34, 1,826.58 and 150.00 are firm; 86.16 (faint pencil, '1' barely inked), 610.51 (leading glyph is unambiguously a cursive 6, not an 8), 1,280.23 (superscript cents degraded) and 329.38 carry residual cent-level doubt - but no cent-level correction can move the sum 200.89, and no cell has a hundreds digit that could be misread by 200 (Home Depot, Rotary and Nation Builder each show only two integer digits; the '6' of 610.51 and the '3' of 329.38 are clean). A brute-force search over every plausible glyph alternative found NO reading that closes on 7,560.88 at all, and closure on 7,710.68 only under a +200 reading of the wrist-band cell that the crop refutes. Published with reconciles=False per gate 4: a human-read ledger that disagrees with its own cover is the FILER's arithmetic, a fact about the document. Sibling cover-differencing is WEAK here and is recorded as such - 4278's Last Report column (7,710.68 / 1,019.12) restates 4020, and it restates it to this LEDGER's total, not to 4020's cover.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: PAGE ORDER IS REVERSED on this filing: p2 is the ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT and p3 is the ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT (page position classified by the printed heading, not by position). p3 boxed '>$50' total, handwritten, reads $8,730.<superscript 00> and the '<=$50' box carries a hand-drawn DASH/tilde nil mark (BLANK under the zero-glyph ruling, and the module's cover cache already records it blank); the 10 real rows sum to 8,730.00 EXACTLY when the 270.00 in-kind row is included, and to 8,460.00 monetary-only. p2 boxed 'Total amount of expenditures' reads $7,710.68 (verified at 1400 dpi on a tight crop of the box) - which is NOT the cover's promoted 7,560.88 but IS the figure the candidate's post-election sibling 4278 carries in its Last Report expenditure column. The 11 real rows sum to 7,509.79, so NEITHER figure gates: -200.89 against the ledger's own printed total, -51.09 against the cover. Both pages carry the blank form's PRINTED SPECIMEN row (p3 'Jon and Jane Doe' $435.00, p2 'Name of Business' $512.00), dropped.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: Handwritten (pencil/ballpoint) ledger on the 2016 split50 Summit form; the county scanner's OCR layer covers only the printed headings, so draft.py returned nothing usable below the header and every row was read from the 200 dpi full-page render with 1400-2000 dpi tight cell crops for the amount column. PAGE ORDER REVERSED (expense p2, contribution p3) - a property the brief does not list. Both printed SPECIMEN rows are present and unstruck and are dropped; on the contribution side the >$50 box closes only without the $435.00 specimen, which is the proof. IN-KIND INCLUDED IN THE COVER FIGURE: the 270.00 'Like-Kind Donation - Auto' from the State Board of Realtors is needed to make the printed >$50 box and the cover's 8,730.00 close - opposite to the established monetary-only precedent, so the contribution side is exact only when the in-kind row is counted. The '<=$50' box holds a hand-drawn dash/tilde nil mark: BLANK, not zero. PRIVACY: the 2016 form prints a 'Mailing Address' column with street addresses; only the CITY and STATE were lifted at read time and no street or PO box is recorded anywhere in this record. Two donors (Scott Simmons, Tom Brown) wrote a city with NO state - honestly blank, never inferred from the zip (both are 84061 Peoa). The 'State Board of Realtors' in-kind row has no address at all - the filer wrote the donation description in the address column, so its city/state are blank because the filer left them empty, not because the county redacted anything (this filing carries NO redactions). The last expense row (Summit County, filing fee, 150.00) has NO date printed: date blank + needs_review=1, never inferred. The filer left small check marks in the left margin of several rows and to the right of most contribution rows - his own tick-off marks, not data. Kevin VanTassell appears twice (2/28/16 and 10/17/16), both 500.00 - two separate contributions, not a duplicate row (dates and bands differ).
